@concat('"SELECT 
MLRSUM.SBSB_LAST_NAME, 
MLRSUM.SBSB_FIRST_NAME, 
MLRSUM.SBAD_ADDR1,
MLRSUM.SBAD_ADDR2, 
MLRSUM.SBAD_CITY, 
MLRSUM.SBAD_STATE, 
MLRSUM.SBAD_ZIP,
MLRSUM.REFUND_AMT,
''9999999999'' AS RCPT_ID,
SYSDATE AS RCPT_CREATE_DTM, 
MLRSUM.SBSB_ID,
 ''MLR'' AS rcpt_mctr_rsn,
 MLRSUM.GRGR_ID, 
 MLRSUM.CSCS_ID, 
 ''"', string(variables('gv_MLRRefundReason')), '"''  AS ATMM_TEXT, 
 ''000'' AS RCPT_CHECK_NO, 
MLRSUM.CSPI_ID,
MLRSUM.RFD_GRPING_KEY

FROM (
SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY SBSB_ID,RFD_GRPING_KEY ORDER BY SBSB_ID, OED DESC ) AS RNK,
MLR.SBSB_LAST_NAME, 
MLR.SBSB_FIRST_NAME, 
MLR.SBAD_ADDR1,
MLR.SBAD_ADDR2, 
MLR.SBAD_CITY, 
MLR.SBAD_STATE, 
MLR.SBAD_ZIP,
(SELECT SUM(REFUND_AMT) FROM AGP.MLR_MEM_MONTHLY_EARNED WHERE SBSB_ID = MLR.SBSB_ID AND MLR.RFD_GRPING_KEY =RFD_GRPING_KEY
GROUP BY SBSB_ID,MLR.RFD_GRPING_KEY)+.01 AS REFUND_AMT,
MLR.SBSB_ID,
 MLR.GRGR_ID, 
 MLR.CSCS_ID, 
MLR.CSPI_ID,
MLR.RFD_GRPING_KEY
FROM AGP.MLR_MEM_MONTHLY_EARNED MLR
WHERE MLR.RFD_GRPING_KEY = ''"', string(variables('gv_MLRGrpKey')), '"''
 ) MLRSUM
WHERE RNK=1 "')

@concat('"SELECT b.SBSB_LAST_NAME, b.SBSB_FIRST_NAME, c.SBAD_ADDR1,c.SBAD_ADDR2, c.SBAD_CITY, c.SBAD_STATE, c.SBAD_ZIP,a.RCPT_AMT,

FROM FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS a 
JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC b on b.sbsb_id = a.RCPT_INPUT_SBSB_ID
JOIN Facets.CMC_SBAD_ADDR c on c.sbsb_ck = b.sbsb_ck AND c.SBAD_TYPE = b.sbad_type_mail 
JOIN Facets.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON GRGR.GRGR_CK= B.GRGR_CK AND a.RCPT_INPUT_GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID 
JOIN Facets.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME on MEME.SBSB_CK = b.SBSB_CK
LEFT JOIN Facets.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK
AND EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe2
            where mepe.meme_ck=mepe2.meme_ck
            HAVING  MIN(CASE WHEN MEPE2.MEPE_ELIG_IND = ''Y'' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)=(CASE WHEN MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = ''Y'' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)

(a.RCPT_MCTR_RSN IN (''DTH'',''TERM'',''ROTH'',''RTOL'',''ROVP'',''RCNR'',''REFT'',''RNBL'',''RPRG'',''RLCE'',''RCSO'' ) AND A.RCPT_INPUT_GRGR_ID = ''KYMCDWP0''))

FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe3
where  MEPE.MEME_CK=mepe3.MEME_CK and MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND=mepe3.MEPE_ELIG_IND
and mepe3.MEPE_EFF_DT < TO_TIMESTAMP(''"', string(variables('gv_FromDate')), '"''  ,''mm/dd/yyyy HH:MI:SS AM''))

AND MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT < TO_TIMESTAMP(''"', string(variables('gv_FromDate')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy HH:MI:SS AM'')

FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe3

FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE3
WHERE  MEPE.MEME_CK=MEPE3.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND=MEPE3.MEPE_ELIG_IND

SELECT  MAX(FRMDATE.RcptCreateDate) as LastRcptCreateDate FROM 
(
SELECT dateadd(ss,1,MAX(RECEIPTCREATEDATE)) as RcptCreateDate
  FROM REFUND.DMSREFUND R
  INNER JOIN REFUND.DMSBATCH B
  ON R.BATCHID = B.BATCHID 
  AND B.BATCHTYPE = 'PRM'
INNER JOIN REFUND.BATCHSTATUS S
  ON B.BatchStatusId = S.BatchStatusId
  AND S.BatchStatus = 'Complete'
  UNION
  SELECT dateadd(ss,1,MAX(RECEIPTCREATEDATE)) as RcptCreateDate 
  FROM REFUND.DMSRefund_Missing_BrandRec ARCH
) FRMDATE
